test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north. No one sits to the right of G. Only three people sit between G and E. Only two people sit between E and F. C sits third to the left of D. K sits to the immediate right of D.

How many people sit between B and F?
solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1. No one sits to the right of G.

2. Only three people sit between G and E.

3. Only two people sit between E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b3c4e285af8d82468892ba0f9193588826e84079bff34bdf532561b7200590d.png] 

4. K sits to the immediate right of D.

5. C sits third to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/883272ed13b78c587171be118f9943e4fdacdab8f00e0efc7d626053bbb94599.png] 

So, **Three **people sit between B and F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Three".
